title: Have meeting
simplified_paragraphs: 今天下午我要开会， 这个会很重要， 但是我没准备好。 中午， 我没时间吃东西， 就在办公室里一边喝咖啡、 吃面包， 一边准备开会的东西。 终于， 在开会前， 我准备好了。
traditional_paragraphs: 今天下午我要開會， 這個會很重要， 但是我沒準備好。 中午， 我沒時間吃東西， 就在辦公室裡一邊喝咖啡、 吃麵包， 一邊準備開會的東西。 終於， 在開會前， 我準備好了。
pinyin_paragraphs: jīn tiān xià wǔ wǒ yào kāi huì，  zhè gè huì hěn zhòng yào，  dàn shì wǒ méi zhǔn bèi hǎo。  zhōng wǔ，  wǒ méi shí jiān chī dōng xi，  jiù zài bàn gōng shì lǐ yī biān hē kā fēi、  chī miàn bāo，  yī biān zhǔn bèi kāi huì de dōng xi。  zhōng yú，  zài kāi huì qián，  wǒ zhǔn bèi hǎo le。
english_paragraphs: I have a meeting this afternoon. This meeting is very important, but I am not ready. At noon, I didn’t have time to eat, so I drank coffee and ate bread in the office while preparing things for the meeting. Finally, before the meeting, I was ready.
english_full: I have a meeting this afternoon. This meeting is very important, but I am not ready. At noon, I didn’t have time to eat, so I drank coffee and ate bread in the office while preparing things for the meeting. Finally, before the meeting, I was ready.
